- 2026-02-26 initial intro (Maya + Diego) — customer: Head of Search = Lena Cho. Wants predictable cost at scale.
- 2026-03-03 product demo: showed hosted API flow, embedding pipeline, reranker fallback. Fireflies id ff_20260303_18:22:14_Coppercove_demo.
- Key quote from Lena: "We need sub-150ms p95 for search+rerank at sustained 600 QPS — anything slower and product UX degrades."
- Current infra: hybrid ElasticSearch + Open-source embedding store; ~800k indexed passages across global tenants (avg 70k per large tenant). Expected growth ~2x in 12 months.
- Workload: high QPS query surface (customer-facing search widgets + in-app assistant) — typical query size short (<=64 tokens), reranker runs top-25 then re-ranks top-5.
- Targets: p95 end-to-end <150ms, cost-per-query target <$0.007 on average (incl. embed + rerank amortization).
- Security: require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for model calls, and EU residency for 20% of tenant data. Legal has additional encryption-at-rest checklist.
- POC plan: 2-week perf POC using Redwood hosted API + dedicated rerank config (quantized model suggestion from Redwood Optimize). Compare against current cost baseline and p95 latency.
- Action items: SE to provide per-1000QPS cost model and batching recommendations; AE to get security mini-SLA sheet to Coppercove legal; schedule stress window 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-20.
- Current sentiment: curious but price-sensitive. Mentioned competitor evals (Algolia + internal reranker).
